title: AI Content Workflow: Take an Educational Video from Idea to Upload | Ep 49
description:
AI Content Workflow: Take an Educational Video from Idea to Upload. Learn with a simple example and a beginner exercise.

AI for Beginners — Episode 49 of 50

What you will learn: Plan a full educational video from idea to upload.
Example: a three-minute tutorial about secure passwords.
Try it: produce a script, shot list and description.
Remember: review accuracy, music rights and thumbnails.

Follow the series in episode order and practice with sample data. Share your question or exercise result in the comments.
